subject: CAIQ evidence: S3 log preservation & control sampling plan
messages:
From: Alicia Reynolds <areynolds@horizonfunds.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Horizon Funds Security <security@horizonfunds.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Horizon - CAIQ evidence: S3 log preservation & sampling request

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our CAIQ review we need the following evidence items tied back to the CSA control IDs we discussed in the questionnaire:

- Confirmation of retention policy for object-level S3 access logs and server access logs (preferred retention >= 90 days).
- A 30-day sample of access logs (server access + CloudTrail) covering at least one of the production buckets used for customer data (preferably US-east-1).
- Key rotation schedule and last-rotation artifact for any KMS keys used to encrypt customer buckets.
- Crosswalk indicating which Redwood systems / buckets / owners map to specific CAIQ control IDs (we've flagged LOG-01, LOG-04, INF-02, CRY-03 for immediate review).

If possible, please provide a short plan for how you'll deliver the artifacts (S3 path or Drive link), nominated owners for each artifact, and expected delivery date. We also need the exported sample logs to be timestamped (UTC) and include the original S3 object names where available.

Appreciate it — Alicia
Security Analyst
Horizon Funds

--
Attachment: horizon-caiq-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 135KB)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Reynolds <areynolds@horizonfunds.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 08:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Horizon - CAIQ evidence: S3 log preservation & sampling request

Alicia —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of the plan we propose:

1) Scope & owners
   - S3 access/server logs (production buckets): owner = Marissa Cole (Platform Reliability)
   - CloudTrail exports for account-level events: owner = Priya Natarajan (Security Controls)
   - KMS rotation artifacts: owner = Ben Carter (Crypto Ops)

2) Retention confirmation
   - Current policy: S3 server access logs and CloudTrail exports are retained for 365 days by default; we retain compressed daily archives in an internal S3 archive bucket (us-east-1). We'll provide the policy doc and bucket lifecycle config.

3) Evidence delivery
   - We will stage a crosswalk (caiq-crosswalk-v2.xlsx) that maps Redwood resources to CAIQ control IDs and include direct links to artifacts.
   - Sample logs: we'll export a 30-day window (requested month can be specified) and place gzipped JSON files in a temporary read-only Drive folder.

4) Timeline
   - Initial deliverables (crosswalk + retention policy pdf + owner list): EOD Friday (2027-02-05).
   - Sample exports and KMS rotation artifacts: by Tue 2027-02-09.

Are you ok with that timeline? If Horizon needs a specific sample month, please let us know (we can prioritize).

I'll loop back with attachments and links as soon as Marissa and Priya confirm the extraction windows.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, Alicia Reynolds <areynolds@horizonfunds.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 15:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Horizon - CAIQ evidence: S3 log preservation & sampling request

Looping in the concrete evidence mappings below — Alicia, this is the short-form mapping we will include in the crosswalk workbook but wanted to surface here for visibility:

- LOG-01 (Access logging): S3 server access logs enabled on prod buckets. Evidence: s3://redwood-archive/logs/s3-access/prod/ (daily gzip, retention=365d). Sample file: sample-cloudtrail-2026-12-15.json.gz (we'll stage a matching S3 access file for the same date).
- LOG-04 (Log integrity & storage): We store compressed daily artifacts in an immutable prefix with MFA-delete disabled for archive copies; lifecycle policy transitions to Glacier after 180 days. Evidence: s3://redwood-archive/lifecycle-policy.json and snapshot of lifecycle config.
- INF-02 (Infrastructure change events): CloudTrail primary account trail exported to s3://redwood-logs/cloudtrail/ (events delivered in JSON, delivered to bucket in us-east-1). Evidence: CloudTrail export manifest + event sample (attached).
- CRY-03 (Encryption key management): KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01. Last rotation performed: 2026-11-18. Evidence: kms-rotation-report-20261118.pdf (attached).

Delivery notes:
- We'll provide the 30-day sample as gzipped JSON bundles and a checksum file.
- All artifacts will be placed in a read-only Drive folder and we will share a one-week link by Tue 2027-02-09.

If Horizon needs logs covering a specific compliance window (e.g., calendar Q4 2026), tell us which dates and we'll prioritize that window.

Thanks,
Priya
Security Controls Manager
Redwood Inference

--

Markus / Priya / Marissa —

Thanks, that timeline works. Two quick follow-ups before you stage the full package:

1) Can you confirm the UTC timestamp format you use for the exported logs (ISO 8601 required).
2) For the sample set, we'd like one day where an admin IAM user performed a PutObject on a production bucket (if available) so we can validate chain-of-custody. If you can mark that sample logfile, please highlight the entry.

If everything looks good we're ready to receive the Drive link and will coordinate the next steps for control annotation on our side.

Appreciate the rapid turn — Alicia
